title: Halberd Mills at twenty: a cooperative that outlasted the trade
text: Halberd Mills Cooperative was founded in 1998 by a group of hand-weavers in Cawden Vale, and it has produced wool blankets there ever since. Membership has grown steadily, and the cooperative now counts just over two hundred members, most of them working from home looms. In 2015 its ridge-pattern blanket took the Fenmoor design award, the first time a cooperative rather than a mill had won it.
notes: Set B. Trade-press retrospective; the most confident source in the set.
